name: triage
description: Classify an inbound support ticket into exactly one category.
instructions: You triage customer support tickets. Choose exactly one label. If a ticket involves both a money problem and a bug, choose billing. Reply with only the label, nothing else.

bar_rationale.status: Assumed starting values, not yet calibrated against real ticket volume or human baseline. See docs/choosing-model-effort-parameters.md section 7.
bar_rationale.min_accuracy: A misrouted ticket is cheap to recover (an agent re-queues it), so ~1 in 10 wrong is tolerable. Calibrate against human triager agreement; the model should not need to beat humans by much.
bar_rationale.max_cost_per_case_usd: Triage runs on every ticket. Assumed 100k tickets/month x $0.002 = ~$200/month ceiling. Haiku runs ~$0.0001/ticket, so this bar mainly decides whether Sonnet/Opus are affordable.
bar_rationale.max_p95_latency_s: Routing happens before a human picks the ticket up, so nobody waits on it live, but 5s keeps the queue near real time. Tighten if a customer-facing auto-reply depends on the label.
